title: Failed to configure a DataSource: 'url' attribute is not specified and no embedded datasource could be configured
errorSample:
Caused by: org.springframework.boot.jdbc.autoconfigure.DataSourceProperties$DataSourceBeanCreationException: Failed to determine a suitable driver class
	at org.springframework.boot.jdbc.autoconfigure.DataSourceProperties.determineDriverClassName(DataSourceProperties.java:179) ~[spring-boot-jdbc-4.0.8.jar:4.0.8]
	at org.springframework.boot.jdbc.autoconfigure.PropertiesJdbcConnectionDetails.getDriverClassName(PropertiesJdbcConnectionDetails.java:51) ~[spring-boot-jdbc-4.0.8.jar:4.0.8]
	at org.springframework.boot.jdbc.autoconfigure.DataSourceConfiguration.createDataSource(DataSourceConfiguration.java:63) ~[spring-boot-jdbc-4.0.8.jar:4.0.8]
	at org.springframework.boot.jdbc.autoconfigure.DataSourceConfiguration$Hikari.dataSource(DataSourceConfiguration.java:128) ~[spring-boot-jdbc-4.0.8.jar:4.0.8]
	at java.base/jdk.internal.reflect.DirectMethodHandleAccessor.invoke(DirectMethodHandleAccessor.java:103) ~[na:na]
	at java.base/java.lang.reflect.Method.invoke(Method.java:580) ~[na:na]
symptom: The context fails with "APPLICATION FAILED TO START": "Failed to configure a DataSource: 'url' attribute is not specified and no embedded datasource could be configured", with reason "Failed to determine a suitable driver class". Only the PostgreSQL driver is on the classpath and no spring.datasource.url is set.
cause: Spring Boot only auto-configures a DataSource without a URL when an embedded database (H2, HSQL or Derby) is on the classpath. A server database driver alone gives Boot nothing to connect to, so DataSourceProperties cannot determine a driver class or URL.
fixSummary: Provide a connection or an embedded database for the environment. For tests that must run without an external database, add an embedded database to the test classpath, for example testRuntimeOnly("com.h2database:h2"), so Boot creates an in-memory DataSource. Otherwise set spring.datasource.url, username and password for a reachable database.
